pages.text: Supply depots still contain guards, carriers, working storage, and restoration materials. Follow their lamps and stone paths to inspect nearby remains. Chests have a 20% chance to contain one seal; recovered books leave clues to core restoration.

Archives hold bookshelves, tablets, extra guards, and an ancient commander. Slime-written records recall the kingdom’s beginning and the silence after XXX left. Each chest has a 35% chance to contain one seal, alongside supplies.

Rarer old royal wards bear crests and banners, with a commander and extra guards. Their chests hold the last watch’s record and have a 50% chance to contain one seal. Ruins appear in new chunks without changing existing builds or saved companions.

Reach The Slimic through a slime-block portal, then explore new surface chunks. Royal wards are rare ruins with crests, old banners, a commander, and extra guards. They have no fixed coordinates or separate entrance.
